docs.summary: Reads MSBuild's canonical diagnostic format into [`BuildIssue`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Build.BuildIssue).
docs.remarks:
MSBuild emits diagnostics in one documented shape, `origin : severity code : message [project]`, where the origin may carry a line and column. Matching that shape recovers the code, the file and the line, which a search for the substring ": error " throws away.

The severity words are localised when the toolchain is, so callers must run the tool with an invariant UI language. [`InvariantEnvironment`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Build.MSBuildDiagnostics~InvariantEnvironment) carries the variables that do it.
